subject: french
title: Stamp 1: The Subjunctive Stamp
welcome_lead: Collect your first language stamp by mastering the French subjunctive mood.
meta_desc: A-Level French grammar adventure on the subjunctive mood, regular and irregular forms, and triggers.
final_note: Stamp earned! You can now spot when le subjonctif is required.

concepts.def: A mood expressing doubt, necessity, emotion, or subjectivity, typically after que.
-e, -es, -e, -ions, -iez, -ent added to the stem of the third-person plural present indicative.
Verbs like etre, avoir, aller, faire, pouvoir, savoir, vouloir that have unique subjunctive stems.
Expressions such as il faut que, bien que, avant que, pour que that require the subjunctive.
A literary tense formed from the past historic stem, rarely used in modern speech.
Compound form using the subjunctive of avoir or etre plus the past participle.

walkthroughs.body_html: Take the third-person plural present indicative of parler: ils parlent. Drop -ent to get the stem parl-. Add subjunctive endings: que je parle, que tu parles, qu'il parle, que nous parlions, que vous parliez, qu'ils parlent.

Etre: que je sois, que tu sois, qu'il soit, que nous soyons, que vous soyez, qu'ils soient. Avoir: que j'aie, que tu aies, qu'il ait, que nous ayons, que vous ayez, qu'ils aient. These must be memorised.
Il faut que tu fasses tes devoirs — it is necessary that you do your homework. Bien qu'il soit fatigue, il travaille — although he is tired, he works. The conjunctions force the subjunctive.
